subject: english
title: Story Clue Crew · Q3 W14 D01
objective: Use details from a story to explain characters, events, and ideas.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Readers use story clues—not guesses alone—to explain what happened and why. Ready to explore?

vocabulary.definition: the person or animal in the story
where and when the story happens
something that happens in the story

activities.instruction: Learn this skill: Use details from a story to explain characters, events, and ideas.
activities.content: Nina heard a soft knock on the door. A little bird had flown into the porch. Nina opened the window, and the bird flew out into the sky.
